$comment: LEGACY, and never given to a candidate. Protocol 3 candidates are offline: they install from the mirror baked into the image (bench/lockdown/image/npm-mirror.lock.json) and their gateway is configured with no mirrors at all. This list is what the gateway may fetch in exactly one situation: re-running, in a box, the gates of a run sealed BEFORE protocol 3 (`pnpm bench score --sandbox`), whose lockfile names package versions the offline mirror does not carry. Each entry is a GET-only reverse proxy to one fixed upstream prefix; every object fetched is hashed into that gate run's log.
